subject: statistics: support adaptive sync load concurrency (#53142)
summary: Adds auto mode for stats sync-load worker concurrency: `performance.stats-load-concurrency` defaults to `0` (auto) and is derived from `runtime.GOMAXPROCS`; session bootstrap maps `0`→auto and clamps negative (tests) to `0`; domain logs the started sub-worker count. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/compatibility/concurrency across the touched planner/session/statistics paths.
